# Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(sf)
library(corrplot)
```

# Data

**iris_ff_indicateurs** : fast-foods par quartier (02_feature_enginneering.qmd)

**transport_iris** : arrêts et lignes par quartier (03_transport_iris.qmd)

```{r}
iris_ff_indicateurs <- readRDS("iris_restos_indicateurs.rds")
transport_iris      <- readRDS("transport_iris.rds")
```

# Jointure

```{r}
base <- iris_ff_indicateurs |> 
  mutate(CODE_IRIS = str_sub(ID, -9)) |> # Code du quartier = 9 derniers caractères de ID
  left_join(transport_iris |> select(-NOM_IRIS), by = "CODE_IRIS")


base <- base |> select(-CODE_IRIS)
nrow(base) # 97 quartiers
ncol(base) # 21 indicateurs 
```
# Analyse descriptive: 

## 3.1 

### 3.1.1 Statistiques descriptives 
```{r}

options(scipen = 999)
base |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  select(nb_resto,nb_resto_rapides,nb_resto_tradi,nb_commerces_total,population,taux_pauv,med_uc,dist_centre_km,superficie_km2) |>
  select(where(is.numeric), -any_of("ID")) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "valeur") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    moy = mean(valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    med = median(valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd=sd(valeur,na.rm=TRUE),
    min = min(valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    Na=sum(is.na(valeur)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(c(moy,med,sd,min,max,Na), ~round(.x, 2)))

  
```

```{r}
# Offre de restauration rapide sur Nantes 

prop_resto<-tibble(
  type_resto=c("Restaurant","Rapide","Traditionnelle"),
  Nombre=c(sum(base$nb_resto),sum(base$nb_resto_rapides),sum(base$nb_resto_tradi)),
  Proportion=c(sum(base$nb_resto)/sum(base$nb_resto),sum(base$nb_resto_rapides)/sum(base$nb_resto),sum(base$nb_resto_tradi)/sum(base$nb_resto))
)

print(prop_resto)
```
```{r}
# les quartiers avec le plus d'Offres:
base |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  select(NOM_IRIS,nb_resto_rapides) |> 
  slice_max(nb_resto_rapides,n=5)
```

```{r}

# 
base |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  select(nb_resto_rapides) |>
  ggplot()+
  aes(x=nb_resto_rapides)+
  geom_bar()+
  labs(x="Nombre d'établissements dans l'IRIS",y="Nombre d'IRIS",title="Nombre de restaurants rapides par IRIS")+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
base |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  select(nb_resto_rapides, nb_resto_tradi) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "type_resto",
    values_to = "nb"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    type_resto = recode(
      type_resto,
      nb_resto_rapides = "Restauration rapide (56.10C)",
      nb_resto_tradi    = "Restauration traditionnelle (56.10A)"
    ) )|> 
      ggplot()+
  aes(x = nb, fill = type_resto)+
      geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ type_resto, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Nombre d'établissements dans l'IRIS",
    y = "Nombre d'IRIS",
    title = "Nombre de restaurants rapides vs traditionnels par IRIS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### 3.1.2 Analyse bivariée



```{r}
# Relation bivarié entre valeurs:
df_num <- base |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(nb_resto_rapides,nb_commerces_total,population,taux_pauv,med_uc,dist_centre_km,superficie_km2, -any_of("ID"))

# 2. Matrice de corrélation
mat_cor <- cor(df_num, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
corrplot(
  mat_cor,
  method = "color",       
  type = "upper",         
  order = "hclust",
  col = COL2("RdBu",100),
  tl.col = "black",       
  tl.srt = 45,            
  number.cex = 0.65,      
  diag = FALSE            
)

```
### 3.1.3 Cartes:
```{r}
# densite de population:
base |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cut(
    population,
    breaks = c(-Inf,500,1000,3000,5000, Inf),
    labels = c("-500","500-1000", "1000-3000","3000-5000", "5000+")
  )), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "OrRd",
    name = "Population"
  ) +
  labs(
  title = "Nombre d'habitants",
  subtitle = "Nantes – Échelle IRIS, 2025",
  fill = "Restaurants / km²",
  caption = paste(
    "Sources : INSEE",
    "Calculs de l'auteur."
  ))+
  theme_void()
```
```{r}
base |>
  mutate(
    revenu_quartile = cut(
      med_uc,
      breaks = quantile(
        med_uc,
        probs = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = c("Q1 - Faible", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 - Élevé")
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_sf(aes(fill = revenu_quartile),
          color = "white",
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Revenu médian"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution spatiale du revenu médian",
    subtitle = "Répartition par quartiles à l'échelle des IRIS",
    caption = "Source : INSEE. Calculs de l'auteur."
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
